expected_response.note: No registered bounded declarative edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective; incumbent fallback is declared.

failure_modes: Selecting a region_index from mixed-sign landmark softmin/occupancy contrasts would be an unsupported directional bet
Editing pointcloud_delta_A cannot express the pair-kernel or shape-moment contrasts because the executing scalar has no such term
A temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region_index edit would rely on contrast curves that fail the declared fidelity rule and require no extrapolation outside [0.0,0.49]
Treating turnover residuals or increment contrasts as causal selection effects would misstate the accounting diagnostics
Treating recorded joint-head survival credit as decoded terminal affinity benefit is unsupported because decoded terminal labels are unavailable
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest signed contrasts are on pair-distance shell densities (endpoint_effects:9-11 positive, endpoint_effects:13 negative; branch_adjusted:163,164,240,241), but the executing pointcloud scalar in formula_registry contains no pair-kernel term, so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can express that contrast; the Analyst itself records this in its limitations. The shape-moment contrasts (endpoint_effects:3,4,8; branch_adjusted:158,235) are likewise not addressable by the registered pointcloud curvature, which is a single scalar delta, not a moment or geometry-block term. Landmark soft-minimum and occupancy contrasts are mixed in sign across regions (endpoint_effects:14,15,20,22,29,31,32,34), so no single region_index is defensibly favored; selecting one would be an unsupported directional bet. Descendant survival credit is weak and not significant after joint multiplicity adjustment (survival_effects:0,23,46,70,100,186,249), and decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available; lineage_support terminal metadata at terminal_index 99, terminal_score_time 0.99, terminal_state_time 1.0, outside the observed window [0.0,0.5]), so last-record joint-head credit cannot justify a change. Increment contrasts disagree in direction with whole-window endpoint contrasts for several features (increment_effects:3,4,7,10,13,14,15), and turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics including score reclassification and extant-parent weighting (turnover:1,14,17,47,134,224,227,254,257,497,524,527,584,587), not causal selection effects. The continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolations over [0.0,0.49] with no extrapolation allowed and multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts (continuous:0-9), and the curve-fidelity audit reports relative node RMSE above the 0.35 acceptance threshold with nonzero strong sign-conflict node counts for the selected features (curve_support), so a time-conditioned teacher blend or temporal region edit is not supported by a validated salience curve. Joint diagnostics are descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit (joint_diagnostics:1,2,11,14), and the information audit is not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian (information_audit; teacher_modes static last-learning-node forecasts). Temperatures are immutable fixed parameters (fixed_parameters; teacher_modes temperature_edits=false) and are not proposed. Because no registered bounded declarative design has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a registered reward recipe that can express the short pair-kernel contrast or a validated time-conditioned salience curve meeting the declared fidelity rule.
